coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to complete the final audit of the PKGBUILD due to an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors so that a single failed request does not force an 'inconclusive' package verdict when the file was already successfully analyzed in an earlier pass.
